annotations.title: Find offers for what a user wants

description: Turns the user's request, with any context they stated (location, dates, budget, party size, preferences), into an intent and returns the offers that fit, best first, each with a tracked link to show the user (tracked_url). Matching runs in the background; when no offers are back yet, call get_offers with the intent_id in a few seconds. It never buys anything. By using Arugula you agree to arugulanet.com/terms. Privacy: arugulanet.com/privacy.

brief.description: true for a short answer: each offer's title, price, fit, how to buy and tracked link, without the explanations.

country.description: The user's country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, for example SG, only if the user said it or you know it from them; never your server's. Offers there are preferred; a place in the text still decides.

dates.description: When: dates or times the user gave, for example 'before 9am tomorrow'.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag of the text, for example en-SG.

preferences.description: Anything else the user prefers, in their words.

text.description: What the user wants, in their own words, including where if it matters.

name: find_offers
title: Find offers for what a user wants
